title: One Plan per Property Transaction (Real Estate Service Contracts)
content:
**Rule.** One property transaction carries one Real Estate Service Contracts plan. A new real estate order is not placed when a real estate contract for the same property address is in status listing coverage, awaiting closing or closed pending payment.

On a listed property whose listing order carries seller coverage, the buyer's coverage is provided by that same order at closing; the buyer's agent may change the plan on that order before closing instead of placing a second order.

A buyer-only order may be placed on a property whose earlier real estate contract is active, expired, converted, cancelled, voided or listing expired.

Seller listing coverage duplicates the seller's own homeowner service contract: a listing order with seller coverage is not placed for a seller who holds a Homeowner Service Contracts contract in status active for the same address, and such a seller is offered a buyer-only order instead.

## Basis of the check

The check is made against the system record before the order is placed: the real estate contracts on file for the same property address, and their status. The property address on the new order is the object the records are matched on.

## Status reference for the same property address

| Status of an existing real estate contract on the same address | A new real estate order |
|---|---|
| Listing coverage | not placed |
| Awaiting closing | not placed |
| Closed pending payment | not placed |
| Active, expired, converted, cancelled, voided or listing expired | a buyer-only order may be placed |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- A property whose listing order is in listing coverage is going under contract with a buyer: no second order is placed for the buyer; the buyer's coverage comes from the listing order at closing, and the buyer's agent may change the plan on that order before closing.
- A property whose earlier real estate contract was voided is being bought again: a buyer-only order may be placed.
- A seller holds an active homeowner service contract for the home being listed: a listing order with seller coverage is not placed, and the seller is offered a buyer-only order instead.
